result_text:
All three default conventions now match the files they were meant for. The new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (13 tests, offline).

**What changed** (`codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`):
- **HTML generated pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `(html|htm|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered.
- **.NET doc XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the path patterns changed from `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` to `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` match. The content rules still require `<doc>` or `// Generated by` within the first lines, so hand-written files stay out.
- **Gradle JS:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

**Test added:** `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the positive cases match (`.htm` pages, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`), that the existing `.html`, `.xhtml` and `build.gradle` cases still match, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.html`, `.xml` and `.js` files do not.

I did not run the new test against the original code to watch it fail first. The fixes follow from reading the patterns and from how `SourceFileFilter` matches paths and content. Nothing is committed.
